# Spike_Encoding_Scheme

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The method of converting continuous network traffic features into spike trains (e.g., rate coding, temporal coding) for SNN input. Determines the information fidelity and energy efficiency of neuromorphic intrusion detection, directly impacting iNEST deployment feasibility.
